market_outlook.short_term: Markets face choppy 1-3 month period. Fed hike creates initial volatility but Dimon's 'mini boom' in small business and earnings-driven momentum (UBS) provide support. Energy inflation and AI safety concerns cap upside. Sentiment at 16-month low suggests oversold conditions may trigger relief rallies. Dollar strength pressures EM and commodity exporters. Watch for second-order effects of diesel crunch on Q4 logistics costs.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook moderately constructive but bifurcated. Data center/AI infrastructure capex cycle remains intact (Eaton, Blackstone, Salesforce). Energy transition and copper demand support materials. Consumer stress may persist through 2027 with Medicare changes and mortgage headwinds. Buffett transition at Berkshire creates uncertainty but succession planning likely orderly. Geopolitical risks (Iran, Russia) remain tail risks. Fed-BoE divergence supports dollar through year-end.
